component.name: Ludonimbus
component.summary: Cloud saves for emulators, recomps and non-Steam games
模拟器、重制版和非 Steam 游戏的云存档

description.p: Ludonimbus keeps the saves of games Steam doesn't sync in your own cloud storage, with a version history, across PCs and handhelds.
Ludonimbus 把 Steam 不同步的游戏存档放进你自己的网盘，带版本记录，电脑和掌机之间共用。
